case_number: 2025 INSC 412; CIVIL APPEAL NO.………………… OF 2025 [ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 19223 OF 2024]
summary: Challenge to dismissal based on lack of Chief Minister's approval of charge-sheet; High Court quashed dismissal on procedural grounds; Supreme Court examined jurisdiction and timing of charge-sheet approval; reliance on B.V. Gopinath and Promod Kumar; issue of whether pre-approval of charge-sheet is mandatory; writ petition entertained despite alternative remedy; analysis of procedural compliance in disciplinary proceedings; impugned judgment under review.
legal_provisions_cited: Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, 1930
Rule 14(xi), Jharkhand Government Servants (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules 2016
Union of India v. B.V. Gopinath
State of Tamil Nadu v. Promod Kumar, IAS
